text: CI's invariant/verify job and its tests' shards set up Python 3.12, the oldest Python Invariant supports, instead of using the runner's python3 (#478). On 2026-11-03 GitHub moved ubuntu-latest from Ubuntu 24.04 to 26.04, and its python3 from 3.12 to 3.14.4. Two of internal/verify's tests assert the reason the gate gives for refusing a contract test, and under 3.14 the gate refuses for another reason, so every pull request that ran them failed. Pinning 3.12 restores what those jobs ran until then, and with invariant/python's 3.13, CI still tests two versions. Supporting 3.14 is its own change, #479. Built by hand, since the factory can't change .github/ on this repository.
